questions.question: What happens to a destroyed Ten Shadows shikigami?
questions.subject: Divine Dog: Totality

answer.item: When a shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique gets killed or destroyed in battle, it can't be summoned or manifested ever again, but its energy is inherited or passed on to the other shikigami.

questions.question: How did the black Divine Dog gain Totality's power?
questions.subject: Divine Dog: Totality

answer.item: In this specific case, the black Divine Dog gained the power of its deceased white twin.

questions.question: What does Totality summon?
questions.subject: Divine Dog: Totality

answer.item: By using Totality, the user can summon a stronger, larger, bi-pedal, bicolored werewolf-like version of the black Divine Dog.
